clue: Born from Walt's 1941 goodwill tour of South America, this 1942 film introduced the Brazilian parrot Jose Carioca.
reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Saludos Amigos! Donald visits Lake Titicaca and Goofy becomes a gaucho. [laughs] Hello, friends, indeed.

clue: In this 1999 sequel to a 1940 classic, Donald Duck helps Noah load the ark to Pomp and Circumstance, and New York swings to Rhapsody in Blue.
reveal: The correct answer is Fantasia 2000! [chuckles] It even brought back The Sorcerer's Apprentice from the original. Brooms everywhere, still.

clue: In this 2004 film, three dairy cows try to save their farm, Patch of Heaven, by catching the yodeling cattle rustler Alameda Slim.
reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Home on the Range! A cow named Maggie, voiced by Roseanne Barr, plus Judi Dench as a proper British cow. Moo-velous.

clue: Released for The Walt Disney Company's 100th anniversary in 2023, this film follows Asha in the kingdom of Rosas.
reveal: The correct answer is Wish! [sighs] A hundred years of wishing on stars, wrapped up in one movie. Sweet.

clue: In this 1961 film, Hayley Mills plays twin sisters who meet at summer camp and swap places to reunite their parents.
reveal: The correct answer is The Parent Trap! [excited] Hayley Mills played both twins thanks to clever split-screen tricks. Let's get together, yeah yeah yeah!

clue: In this 1944 film, Donald Duck teams up with a Brazilian parrot named José Carioca and a Mexican rooster named Panchito Pistoles.
reveal: [excited] The correct answer is The Three Caballeros! You can still find all three birds together at Epcot's Mexico pavilion boat ride. Ay, caramba!

clue: This 2000 Disney film placed computer-animated creatures, including an iguanodon named Aladar, over real live-action backgrounds.
reveal: The correct answer is Dinosaur! [laughs] Not to be confused with Pixar's The Good Dinosaur. Those are two very different reptiles.

clue: In this 1977 film mixing live action and animation, an orphan boy's best friend is a sometimes-invisible dragon named Elliott.
reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is Pete's Dragon! Elliott the dragon lights the lighthouse in a little Maine town. Handy friend to have.
